from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEpsEntry(BaseModel):
    """A single EPS record extracted from one financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    eps_basic: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share value; negative indicates a loss")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for the EPS line item in the document")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text excerpt containing the EPS value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_entries: list[CompanyEpsEntry]
